text: After pre-ripening, Comté goes through a separate fermentation stage and then ripening, and its paste can show some openings up to the size of a small cherry. Long ripening with a rubbed smear rind builds fruity (hazelnut, citrus) and toasted aromas.

steps.note: The milk is pre-ripened for at least 40 min before the rennet.
Into wheels of 50–70 cm, 35–45 kg at day 50.
Pre-ripened to day 21 or later, fermented, then ripened, with a smear rind rubbed with a solution kept at 13 °C or below.
